name: Stochastic of Finance
description: Basic stochastic process involved in the study of mathematics of finance, martingales, Brownian motion, geometric Brownian motion, Itô calculus, Itô formula, stochastic differential equations, strong solution, weak solution, derivative security pricing, change of measure, martingale representation theorem, Girsanov’s theorem, option pricing, Feymann-Kac theorem, Black-Scholes model, forward contracts and bond pricing, Vasicek model, CIR model, Hull-White model, Monte-Carlo simulation, random number generation, simulation of Black-Scholes model, simulation of stochastic differential equation, simulation models for option pricing.
